missions.title: INTEL RUN
missions.subtitle: Recover encrypted intel from the outpost and deliver it to R5-D8
missions.briefing:
Operative, a rebel sympathizer at the Twin Suns Cantina has dead-dropped an intel package for us.

Find the datacard at the outpost, take it to the Repair Shop Decoder to decrypt, and hand the coordinates to R5-D8 who is hiding in the storage facility.

Imperial patrols are sweeping the area. Stay low.

steps.title: Pick up the Datacard
steps.description: Search the cantina and cafe for an INTEL_01 datacard. Scan it on your datapad.

steps.title: Decrypt at the Repair Shop
steps.description: Carry the encrypted vault key DT_VAULT to the Repair Shop Terminal and scan it on the terminal reader.

steps.title: Deliver to R5-D8
steps.description: Find R5-D8 in the storage facility, purge his scrambled memory core, and hand off the decrypted intel.

missions.title: EXTRACTION
missions.subtitle: Signal the shuttle and get off-world before the Empire locks down the outpost
missions.briefing:
The coordinates are with R5 -- now Command wants you out alive.

The cantina comm board can reach the shuttle on the outpost's open channel, but you'll have to slice through its security first. Broadcast the extraction signal, then get to the landing zone and scan the extraction beacon.

Move fast. The Empire traces every wideband burst.

steps.title: Signal the shuttle
steps.description: Slice the Cantina Comm Board and broadcast the extraction signal on the open channel.

steps.title: Reach the extraction point
steps.description: Get to the landing zone and scan the EXTRACT_01 beacon to confirm pickup.

missions.title: COUNTER-SLICE
missions.subtitle: Trace the rebel slicer network and seize their dead drop
missions.briefing:
ISB has flagged slicer traffic on the cantina's backroom comm board. The rebels are moving something through this outpost.

Breach the board yourself and pull its private ledger, then locate the dead-dropped datacard before their courier collects it. Log it as evidence.

The Empire rewards efficiency.

steps.title: Breach the comm board
steps.description: Slice the Cantina Comm Board's pattern lock and recover its backroom ledger.

steps.title: Seize the dead drop
steps.description: Locate the rebel datacard INTEL_01 and scan it to log it as evidence.
